scope: Local macOS maintainer-observer development. No full signed preparation, Linux kernel, complete consumer lifecycle, RC1 acceptance or release claim.

actual_unchanged_adapter_controls.source_reuse: Later gates compare source maps and permit only consumer_runtime.rs changes; adapter and control sources remain identical.

selected_os_git.effect: Selected Developer Git version and real public HTTPS shallow fetch succeed under exact execution policy. GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null match the production ConsumerSession; templates are explicitly disabled.

actual_upstream_installer.effect: The exact hash-pinned upstream rust-src install.sh executes successfully through its real shebang, writes the owned fresh prefix, and installs core source bytes matching the archive. The enclosing a4 campaign later fails at Git helper lookup; installer success is not a full campaign PASS. a5 reuses this narrowly scoped installer result and rechecks the installed bytes.

policy_changes: write-null accepts only literal canonical OS null character device and records before/after device/inode/rdev, without invented content hashes. Linux exact device WRITE_FILE plus ABI3+ TRUNCATE; actual Linux kernel gate pending.
Mac system.sb already allows null writes. Omission remains allowed on Mac and must refuse on Linux; invalid /dev/zero directive refuses before child launch on both. Mac actual12 cases pass.
Only cold preparation declares explicit null-device write. Nested stdin reads are declared for every host phase.
Mac selected Git transport-helper directory is readable for helper/alias lookup. This adds no directory execution permission; only exact hashed Git/HTTP helper executables may run.
Denied pinned Python executable uses the actual bootstrap/runtime/python layout. A fixture checks the layout.
failures_retained: a1 component control incorrectly expected Mac null-write omission to refuse; actual system profile allows it. Corrected expectation and added malformed-directive actual counterprobe.
a1 cold discovery used an unsupported git var query. Production source-init already disables templates, so the unnecessary discovery and reads were removed.
a2 cold native /usr/bin/git follows hidden xcrun forwarding and fails. A separate public source-Git selection fix is being qualified before observer integration.
a3 direct Git probe initially omitted the production isolated Git configuration; probe corrected without granting system Git config reads.
a4 HTTPS probe cannot find helper alias under the previous read policy. Read-only selected helper lookup is declared; a5 actual HTTPS fetch succeeds.
independent_review: Both backend null-device rules and report validity paths were reviewed independently of their author; no concrete remaining issue found within that scope.
remaining: Integrate separately qualified public macOS Git selection fix, then refresh observer delivery on its merged source.
Actual Linux kernel controls, complete protected signed both-host lifecycle and unchanged RC1-A1-A4 matrix remain required.
Public prepare SIGTERM, explicit legacy migration and version/ownership-preservation cases remain open; do not infer them from this development proof.
